M08 viewport streaming: CI browser lanes fail consistently on PR #992 (branch `codex/run-41474031461-1`, merged with main; keep everything already on the branch). Continue on that branch. apps/web only.

EVIDENCE (four consecutive heads bf0e593c, 1c4e60c1, 0c2a46d4, 47ba0fbf — all with `Svelte Web E2E (Cypress, chrome)` = success but `Svelte Web E2E (Cypress, firefox)` = failure and `Review Lab` = failure; the same lanes pass on main):
1. Firefox product journey, test "ranks the pinned Flexible B corpus, retains URL selection and restores Finder history": `waitForExploreSettled` times out after 20 s because `.results-panel` keeps `aria-busy="true"` (with F4 on, `updatingResults` — the ranking/results query never settles within 20 s). Chrome passes the same step.
2. Review Lab (`apps/web/cypress/e2e/review-lab.cy.ts`, isolated review API on 127.0.0.1:8001 that serves only /api/health, /api/local/search, /api/archetypes/rankings and /api/review/scenario/*): typing "Review Wiring" in the anchor search shows "Searching catalogue…" for 13 s and the `[role="option"]` never appears although both /api/local/autocomplete GETs returned 200; the screenshot also shows the page firing `/api/map/heatmap` and watchlist requests. The report lists no unexpected API or console errors.
Hypothesis: M08 now issues up to `MAX_GALAXY_STAR_ACTIVE_CELLS = 16` concurrent `/api/map/catalogue-viewport` cell requests per settled camera (each a bounded DB query with the detail-band row limit), plus refinements. Firefox (6 connections per host, slower) queues the ranking/autocomplete requests behind them and the UI never settles in time; the Review Lab API has no catalogue-viewport route, so those requests sit on the Vite proxy and starve the autocomplete. Verify this by reading the lane logs/videos if available (`gh run view` on the latest #992 run is fine) or by reproducing with throttled connections, then fix the root cause — do not raise Cypress timeouts and do not weaken the Review Lab contract.

WHAT TO DO:
- Bound in-flight catalogue cell requests (e.g. at most 4 at a time, nearest-to-focus first; the rest queued and cancelled when the viewport moves on), coalesce adjacent cells into one request when the API bounds allow, and never let catalogue streaming block or delay the results/ranking, autocomplete, density or journey queries (lower priority, start after the results query settles, or defer cell fetches behind a short idle delay after camera settle).
- At galaxy/overview scale keep the single wide sample request; do not fan out cells until the camera is within the local band.
- In environments where the catalogue-viewport route is absent/unavailable (Review Lab), fail fast once (503/404 → the existing 'Exact-star layer unavailable' state) and stop retrying per cell.
- Tests: galaxy-star-query concurrency/priority (max in flight, cancellation on viewport change, no retry storm on 404/503), workload test counts updated honestly, and keep the product-journey and review-lab specs unchanged unless an assertion is genuinely wrong (explain if so).
- Run `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. Amend the existing M08 CHANGES.md entry (no new heading).
